query:
SELECT
                u.macro_user_id,
                mui.first_name as "first_name?",
                mui.last_name as "last_name?",
                u."isAgent" as is_agent
            FROM "User" u
            LEFT JOIN macro_user_info mui ON mui.macro_user_id = u.macro_user_id
            WHERE u.macro_user_id = $1
